  const ATTRIBUTION_HANDOFF_KEY = 'od.localeAttribution';
  const DEFAULT_LOCALE = "en";
  const LOCALES = [{"code":"en","htmlLang":"en"},{"code":"zh","htmlLang":"zh-CN"},{"code":"ja","htmlLang":"ja"},{"code":"ko","htmlLang":"ko"},{"code":"de","htmlLang":"de"},{"code":"fr","htmlLang":"fr"},{"code":"ru","htmlLang":"ru"},{"code":"es","htmlLang":"es"},{"code":"pt-br","htmlLang":"pt-BR"},{"code":"it","htmlLang":"it"},{"code":"tr","htmlLang":"tr"}];
  const codes = new Set(LOCALES.map((locale) => locale.code));
  // Legacy alias prefixes the catch-all route still emits (zh-CN, es-ES, fa,
  // hu, th) that are NOT canonical LANDING_LOCALES. They must count as a
  // strippable locale segment, or switching language on an alias page like
  // /zh-CN/blog/ would rebuild a nested, non-existent /<locale>/zh-CN/blog/.
  // Mirrors LEGACY_LOCALE_PREFIXES in app/localization/path.ts.
  const legacyAliases = new Set(["zh-cn","zh-tw","es-es","fa","hu","th"]);
  const isLocaleSegment = (segment) => {
    const value = (segment || '').toLowerCase();
    return value !== '' && (codes.has(value) || legacyAliases.has(value));
  };

    if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.trim() === '') return null;
    const raw = value.toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, '-');
    if (raw === 'zh-cn' || raw === 'zh-hans' || raw.startsWith('zh-hans-')) return 'zh';

      raw === 'zh-hk' ||
      raw === 'zh-mo' ||
      raw === 'zh-tw' ||
      raw === 'zh-hant' ||
      raw.startsWith('zh-hant-')

      return codes.has('zh-tw') ? 'zh-tw' : 'zh';
    }
    if (raw === 'pt' || raw.startsWith('pt-br')) return 'pt-br';
    if (codes.has(raw)) return raw;
    const base = raw.split('-')[0];
    return codes.has(base) ? base : null;

    const first = window.location.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean)[0]?.toLowerCase();
    return first && codes.has(first) ? first : DEFAULT_LOCALE;
  };

  const basePathFromCurrent = () => {
    const parts = window.location.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    if (parts[0] && isLocaleSegment(parts[0])) parts.shift();
    return parts.length > 0 ? `/${parts.join('/')}/` : '/';

  // <html data-locale-canonical="true">. Switching language must stay on the
  // single canonical URL — building /<locale>/... would 404.
  const isCanonicalOnly = () =>
    document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-locale-canonical') === 'true';

  const searchWithoutLocaleHandoff = () => {
    const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    searchParams.delete('od_locale');
    const search = searchParams.toString();
    return search ? `?${search}` : '';

  // links exist, so the html data-locale-hrefs map is required; body
  // [data-locale-link] is the post-DOM fallback.
  const serverHrefFor = (locale) => {
    const attr = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-locale-hrefs');
    if (attr) {
      try {
        const map = JSON.parse(attr);
        if (map && typeof map === 'object' && typeof map[locale] === 'string' && map[locale] !== '') {

          cancelClose();

    // variant does not exist, so a zh-preference visitor would hit a 404.

    // Pages that are localized but opt OUT of the on-load auto-redirect (e.g.
    // design-system detail pages): keep the visitor on the URL they clicked.
    // hreflang + manual language switching stay intact.
    if (document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-locale-autoredirect') === 'off') return;

    // then consume it so a later manual language choice remains authoritative.

        const target = targetFor(requested);
        const targetPath = new URL(target, window.location.href).pathname;

          selectLocale(requested, false, 'explicit_handoff');

    try {
      saved = normalizeLocale(window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ?? '');

  // at the top of <head> (as on the homepage), a non-English visitor on the
  // English root is redirected to their locale before the browser finishes
  // streaming the document — aborting the wasted first-load of a page they were
  // never going to keep. autoAdapt only reads location / navigator / storage
  // and html attributes, all available before <body> exists.
  autoAdapt();
  // bindSwitchers needs the switcher DOM, so defer it to DOMContentLoaded when
  // this script runs in <head> (a no-op delay when it runs late in <body>).
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bindSwitchers, { once: true });
  } else {
    bindSwitchers();
  }
})();
